sources.evidence: Table of 82 team rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, headed 'The 2023 ICPC Greece Programming Contest'.
14-page PDF with eight problems headed Problem 1 to Problem 8, each with statement, input, output and samples.

greece-2024.notes: Site copy: English front page still promotes GRCPC 2023; Greek pages are the 2024 edition. Wayback capture mixes dates (copyright 2024 and 2025).

sources.evidence: The Greek-language pages state the GRCPC 2024 edition and a date of 18-19 October 2024, while the English front page still announces GRCPC 2023.
Codeforces gym standings page titled '2024 ICPC Greece Regional Collegiate Programming Contest (GRCPC 2024)' with a 20-team table and columns A to H.
Table of 104 ranked rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation under the title 'The 2024 ICPC Greece Collegiate Programming Contest'.
Codeforces gym dashboard of the 2024 GRCPC listing problems A to H with names.

greece-2025.notes: Site front page now advertises GRCPC 2026 (24/10/2026). Site PDFs say problem E was removed from the global standings; CF board counts 9 problems, API standings (6 solved at top) appear to use the adjusted result. No contest day for 2025 is stated in our copy.

sources.evidence: The site has a GRCPC 2025 page with thank-you text and photos from the sites, plus three 2025 scoreboard PDFs, but its front page now announces GRCPC 2026.
Codeforces gym standings page for GRCPC 2025 with 79 team rows against problems A to I.
Table of 76 ranked rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation under the title 'The 2025 ICPC Greece Collegiate Programming Contest'.
Codeforces gym dashboard of GRCPC 2025 listing problems A to I with names.

greece-2026.notes: The Codeforces contest is titled Greece and Cyprus; no document in our copy states the contest day.

sources.evidence: Table of 95 team rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation, Site citation under the title '2026 ICPC Greece Collegiate Programming Contest'.
Codeforces gym dashboard 'Greece and Cyprus Collegiate Programming Contest 2026' listing problems A to M with names.
